title: Breath Of The Plains
description: A Breath Of The Wild Themed Mod
body:
A Breath Of The Wild Mod For Minecraft Java that Adds: The Master Sword, And Master Sword Shrine, The Sheikah Slate (With Bomb Runes, others will be added later), The Lost Woods Biome, And Much More Still To Come!
